players.name: Dario Vukovic
players.scouting_report: Uses a long stride and a high release, working the edges before climbing the zone.
players.field_note: Keeps a folded paper scorecard from his first professional start inside his travel bag.

players.name: Kaito Natsume
players.scouting_report: Repeats a compact delivery and changes pace without changing his arm speed.
players.field_note: Can identify the clubhouse card players by the sound of their chairs moving.

players.name: Adewale Bamidele
players.scouting_report: Works quickly with a sinking fastball and fields his position with little wasted movement.
players.field_note: Uses a different pencil for each month of his pitching notebook.

players.name: Lucian Ionescu
players.scouting_report: A left-hander who changes eye levels and holds runners with a short first move.
players.field_note: Checks the wind by watching a loose thread on the bullpen flag.

players.name: Ismail Benjeloun
players.scouting_report: Pairs a firm fastball with a late-breaking slider and attacks the outer third.
players.field_note: Repairs the torn pockets of his own warmup jackets.

players.name: Seamus Keary
players.scouting_report: Keeps a fast tempo in relief and works from the same release point with two pitches.
players.field_note: Collects the little paper envelopes used to hold visiting-park meal vouchers.

players.name: Rafiq Qureshi
players.scouting_report: Locates a riding fastball above the hands before using a changeup below the zone.
players.field_note: His spare sports glasses travel in a case marked with the wrong uniform number.

players.name: Tomasz Wierzbicki
players.scouting_report: A right-handed reliever who prefers soft contact and covers the first-base side cleanly.
players.field_note: Counts the stitches across a baseball while waiting for the bullpen phone.

players.name: Tomer Barzilai
players.scouting_report: Sets a quiet target, blocks low pitches and makes direct throws from a compact transfer.
players.field_note: Keeps a small brush for cleaning the dirt from the buckles of his chest protector.

players.name: Enzo Carvajal
players.scouting_report: A left-handed hitter with a patient first look and a long reach at first base.
players.field_note: He and Inés disagree about whether a clean uniform counts as lucky.

players.name: Nils Adebayo
players.scouting_report: A switch-hitting second baseman with quick feet and a short exchange on the double play.
players.field_note: Draws unfamiliar ballparks from memory on the backs of bus receipts.

players.name: Jae-min Seok
players.scouting_report: Keeps his hands inside the ball and takes direct routes to grounders in the hole.
players.field_note: Taps his batting-glove straps in the same order before stepping into the box.

players.name: Pavel Hrynko
players.scouting_report: A right-handed corner infielder who reads hard contact early and drives pitches to the gaps.
players.field_note: Writes the names of borrowed bats on a strip of tape inside his locker.

players.name: Malik Doumbia
players.scouting_report: A left-handed outfielder who closes space with short first steps and throws on the run.
players.field_note: Carries the team’s smallest travel chess set and insists all pieces are present.

players.name: César Iglesiarias
players.scouting_report: Uses the middle of the field at the plate and reads the ball off the bat in center.
players.field_note: His family can spot his batting helmet by a small patch of missing paint.

players.name: Ari Kasprzyk
players.scouting_report: A right-handed hitter with a level swing and a quick release from right field.
players.field_note: Uses an old laundry bag to separate game cleats from everything else in his suitcase.
